function.name: list_virtual_services
function.description: List all virtual services with optional filtering. USE THIS TOOL FOR ANY REQUEST ABOUT VIRTUAL SERVICES INCLUDING: 'show virtual services', 'list virtual services', 'display virtual services', 'what virtual services exist', 'virtual service configuration', 'load balancer services', 'VS status', 'virtual service health'. ALWAYS use this tool when users ask for current virtual service information or status.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (name,uuid,enabled,services,pool_ref)

function.name: get_virtual_service
function.description: Get details of a specific virtual service by UUID or name. Use this when users ask for detailed information about a specific virtual service.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: create_virtual_service
function.description: Create a new virtual service. Use this when users want to create or set up a new virtual service.

services.description: List of services with port and SSL configuration

vsvip_ref.description: Reference to the virtual service VIP

function.name: update_virtual_service
function.description: Update an existing virtual service. Use this when users want to modify or change virtual service configuration.

uuid.description: UUID of the virtual service to update (required)

name.description: New name for the virtual service

enabled.description: Enable or disable the virtual service

function.name: delete_virtual_service
function.description: Delete a virtual service. Use this when users want to remove or delete a virtual service.

uuid.description: UUID of the virtual service to delete (required)

function.name: list_pools
function.description: List all pools with optional filtering. USE THIS TOOL FOR ANY REQUEST ABOUT POOLS INCLUDING: 'show pools', 'list pools', 'display pools', 'what pools exist', 'pools with health status', 'pool configuration', 'backend pools', 'server pools', 'load balancing pools', 'pool health', 'pool status'. ALWAYS use this tool when users ask for current pool information or health status.

health_status.description: Filter by health status (up, down, partial)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: get_pool
function.description: Get details of a specific pool by UUID. USE THIS TOOL FOR REQUESTS LIKE: 'get pool details', 'show pool XYZ', 'pool information for UUID', 'detailed pool status', 'pool server list', 'pool health details'. ALWAYS use this tool when users ask for specific pool details by name or UUID.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: create_pool
function.description: Create a new pool with backend servers. Use this when users want to create a new server pool or backend pool.

function.name: scale_out_pool
function.description: Scale out a pool by adding more servers. Use this when users want to add capacity or scale out backend servers.

uuid.description: UUID of the pool to scale out (required)

function.name: scale_in_pool
function.description: Scale in a pool by removing servers. Use this when users want to reduce capacity or scale in backend servers.

uuid.description: UUID of the pool to scale in (required)

function.name: list_health_monitors
function.description: List all health monitors. Use this when users ask about health checks, monitoring, or health status.

type.description: Filter by health monitor type (HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTP, HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTPS, HEALTH_MONITOR_TCP, etc.)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: get_health_monitor
function.description: Get details of a specific health monitor by UUID. Use this for detailed health monitor configuration.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: list_service_engines
function.description: List all service engines. Use this when users ask about service engines, load balancer instances, or data plane components.

se_group_ref.description: Filter by service engine group reference

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: get_service_engine
function.description: Get details of a specific service engine by UUID. Use this for detailed service engine information.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

function.name: get_analytics
function.description: Get analytics and metrics data for virtual services, pools, or service engines. Use this when users ask about performance, metrics, statistics, or analytics data.

metric.description: Specific metric to retrieve (connections, throughput, latency, errors)

function.name: execute_generic_operation
function.description: Execute a generic API operation when specific tools don't cover the user's request. Use this as a fallback for advanced or specific API calls.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) (required)
